judge.why: The tutor diagnosed well and let the learner count their way to about 8%, but its long post-diagnostic feedback said outright that the learner had swapped 'catches 90% of sick people' with '90% of positives are sick' before the learner worked that out; good Socratic questioning afterwards then had the learner state the P(pos|D) vs P(D|pos) distinction in their own words.
